result = action(['LEFT'])

for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'Y':
        b = n['boundary']
        print(f"Agent: {b}")

pink_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'P']
for n in pink_nodes:
    b = n['boundary']
    print(f"Pink: {b}")
    
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")

        if n['color'] == 'Y':

        adj = seg['adjacency_list']
        agent_id = agent_node['id']
        pink_id = pink_nodes[0]['id']
        is_adj = any((a == agent_id and b == pink_id) or (a == pink_id and b == agent_id) for a, b in adj)
        print(f"Agent adjacent to pink: {is_adj}")

# Try clicking pink block now that agent is close
if pink_nodes:
    n = pink_nodes[0]
    b = n['boundary']
    min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
    max_r = max(p[0] for p in b)
    min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
    max_c = max(p[1] for p in b)
    center_r = (min_r + max_r) // 2
    center_c = (min_c + max_c) // 2
    print(f"\nClicking pink at ({center_r},{center_c})")
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c}])
    print(f"Result: {last_action_result}")
    
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    pink_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'P']
    print(f"Pink after click: {len(pink_nodes)}")
    print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")

</function>
</tool_call>
